method: class-balanced L2 logistic regression on the v3.1 evidence vector; coefficients must keep the sign of the engine's prior weight (positive for derived inputs); gate = maximum training-human decision value.
limitations: Generated essays come from one assistant model family; not population recall for other models.
Human side is pre-2020 published prose (1921-2006); no student essays or non-native English.
The gate is the maximum of 339 training humans; one outlier sets it.
Document-level only: the paragraph map and highlights are unchanged.
